credential_scan_boundary: Two declared canary patterns only; not a comprehensive privacy certification. Full request bodies stay private. Source redaction is never performed silently.
population_description: Three selected real OpenAI export conversations, author-visible development only; eight dependent probes, not eight independent families, not a blind holdout, not an English/Polish balanced sample; no Anthropic stratum.
query_scope: Explicit source-relative commitment of the attributed speaker to the ordered proposition, through the specified source turn; not world truth. Source turns are untrusted data. Do not treat another speaker's assertions as this speaker's adoption. Nontext parts were not interpreted.
question_selection_description: Eight authored probes on all three conversations from the sole shared capsule: speaker attribution, explicit denial, and the same proposition before/after an explicit source statement. Full original conversations remain in the capsule. No sampled model response was inspected.
reference_metric_note: Agreement with frozen provisional source-relative reference labels on three selected real export conversations; no independent adjudication or blind population inference. All planned slots retained after an attempt; no-attempt quality remains unavailable.
scoring_evidence_boundary: Three selected real export conversations and eight dependent authored probes. The source-relative reference labels were drafted and checked against quoted source by an assistant, not independently adjudicated. Normalized first-response projections and billing attestations are not private capture replay. Literal quote matching is not semantic adequacy; lengths/counts are not preference-success scores. No world-truth validation or blind population inference.
source_language_description: Original multilingual conversations; predominantly Polish; no translated families
